exposure: maternal level of knowledge on EPNC
long waiting time before receiving PNC services
distance walked to health unit (<5 km)
antenatal care (ANC) clinic attendance (at least four times)
receiving PNC information from health workers during ANC/childbirth
advised at discharge to turn up for PNC follow-up
outcome: utilization of early postnatal care (EPNC) services
receipt of EPNC consistent with WHO recommendations
cohort: The study included a sample of 234 postpartum women at Masafu General Hospital in Busia District, Eastern Uganda.
finding: While 64.5% of postpartum mothers utilized EPNC services within the first week post-delivery, only 30.5% received care consistent with WHO recommendations, with various demographic and service-related factors significantly influencing EPNC utilization.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with increased odds of using early postnatal care services.
